sections.text: مقدمة

This document outlines the 
equipment inspection checklist I1, which must performed on an annually bases as 
indicated by Y1 in the title block

المواصفات الفنية لل 
المولد الرئيسي: الجهد المقنن 17.5 كيلو فولت والتيار الثابت 7560 أمبير 
التردد المقدر 50 هرتز والسرعة المقدرة 100 دورة في الدقيقة الطاقة المقدرة 175/206 ميجاوات / ميجا فولت أمبير

The first draft is initiated by eng. Ragab 
Mohamed Aly, reviewed by eng. Gamal Hassan Mohamed Hammad,
accepted by eng. Badr Ibrahem Abdel Gawad 
general director, and approved by eng. Abdel Karem Abu Zied Ismaiel; Head Sector 
of High Dam Hydraulic Power Station, Hyd.EPCo., and 
certified by eng. 
Kamel Ragheb Hakem HEPC MPIS coordinator.
احتياطات السلامة

يجب إصدار تصريح العمل والصيانة المؤهلة 
 يجب أن يحمل الموظفون فئة السلامة المناسبة.

Maintenance staff should be will trained and qualified or directly supervised 
 by some one who is.

سياج أمان مع علامات تحذيرية تحيط بمنطقة العمل 
 is required.

Wear your 
 safety and healthy equipment as safety helmet, safety shoes,...etc
Switch off the CB (B-1G) 15.75kv
مفتاح وحدة العازل (P-1G) جهد 15.75 ك.ف
Switch off the VT of (main generator - Aux.) for the unit.

Switch off the automatics F 403 (D.C control of 
 the start / stop unit operation), 72D2 - 7 (DC auto. for control of CB, 
 unit filed, BF protection) 72 A-11, (AC auto. control supply circuit for auditing 
 rotor of Aux. generator insulation device), 72 A - 13 (AC auto. for control supply circuit of 
 auditing rotor of main generator insulation device), 14AG (AC auto for control circuit of for the unit 
 disconnector)
Switch of the AJB (on/of switch for Aux. generator)

Shunt rheostats (the resistance for control 
 valtage of Aux. generator) in max. resistance value position

Switch on the earthling for main generator (Z - 1G), 
 Aux.G(Z-1BG) for the unit.

Stoppers on (blocking for servo 
 motor), close valve no.7 (controller in the entrance pressure in two direction 
 open/close gates)

Switch on the two supplies of (high pressure 
 pump)
Presence of industrial safety supervisor

sections.text: العمل المراد تنفيذه

تفكيك لوحة حديدية واحدة 
فوق مساعد. عزل المولدات

Dismantle bus bars of Aux. 
generator and put insulation wedges between the terminals

تفكيك فرش (الرئيسية 
& مساعد. مولد وغيره. مولد) للوحدة

Dismantle bus bars of VT 
for main generator and (isolator & earth) of the reator

Perform HV test for main 
and aux. generator.

Take sample oil for 
chemical test

Check the brushes for 
exciter gen and measure the air gap for exciter generator.

Clean the filters by used 
air vacuum and clean the slip rings

Clean the main and Aux. 
poles for exciter generator.

تحقق من الفرش و 
حلقات زلات للمفتاح الرئيسي والمساعد. مولد

Clean the surface of the 
rotor for the main generator and clean surface of poles from top.

Check the connection tight 
between the poles.

Retighten all the bus bars 
for the unit.
